environment_failure_repro.summary: The initial rig/full run on the exact prelim head d235f6c0 turned crossing-review red with 101 passed, 1 failure; the failing assertion was 'PICTURE_OF_SEVEN is the sim pictureOfSeven', with the actual stdout starting with 'Google Cloud OpenTelemetry Trace exporter for Go is deprecated...' (a Go-runtime deprecation warning from the OpenTelemetry exporter written to the captured child-process stdout before the sim's own pictureOfSeven payload). The exact same base fc9f73e55ba6e2664c728cc016b838b102c21044, same head d235f6c0, and same test/UI/sim blobs reproduce the failure while the inherited environment variables GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT, OTLP_GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT, and OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT are present, and pass cleanly with only those three variables removed (crossing-review 102 passed, 0 failures). No source/assertion/pin was weakened; the exact-head whole suite was restarted fresh in that measured local environment. The first failed run remains evidence, not erased.

first_run_initial_failure.head: d235f6c0bd00474b957b0a47a0d57606faecc380
first_run_initial_failure.failing_assertion: PICTURE_OF_SEVEN is the sim's pictureOfSeven (captured stdout actually began with 'Google Cloud OpenTelemetry Trace exporter for Go is deprecated and will be archived after January 1st, 2027. Please migrate to the OpenTelemetry OTLP exporters. ...')
first_run_initial_failure.observed_duration: about 28 min; assertion failure, not watchdog timeout
first_run_initial_failure.verdict: real, observed failure on the exact head

independent_assessment.root_cause: The Google Cloud OpenTelemetry Trace exporter for Go writes a deprecation warning to stdout/stderr at startup, and exports only when at least one OTEL-related environment variable is set; setting/keeping those variables in the rig's inherited ambient environment caused the deprecation text to be captured into the crossing-review child-process test's expected output, breaking a strict-prefix equality assertion on pictureOfSeven.
independent_assessment.weakening_of_source_or_assertion_or_pin: none - no byte in sim/, tests/, Makefile, tools/, or fixtures was changed between the trace_env and clean_env runs
independent_assessment.fix_locality: the fix lives in the test environment (unset three OTEL/Google-Cloud env vars), not in the repository; this is consistent with the upstream Go OpenTelemetry exporter's documented behavior
independent_assessment.closes_ambient_failure: yes, with three qualifications: (1) the first failure remains on disk as evidence and is not erased; (2) the fix is environment-scoped, not source-scoped, so a future rig session that re-inherits those env vars will reproduce the failure; (3) a permanent fix in the form of 'crossing-review-test strips Go-runtime deprecation lines from captured child stdout' or a pinned 'unset OTEL_* at rig start' wrapper script is the right hardening, but is out of this child's scope and is recorded as a future item below.
